Shell(node -e "const WebSocket=require('ws'); const ws=new WebSocket('ws://localhost:3100/'); let step=0; const send=(t,d)=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({t,d})); ws.on('open',()=>{console.log('WS OPEN'); send('signup',{username:'tester01',password:'secret123'});}); ws.on('message',(m)=>{const r=JSON.parse(m); console.log('MSG:',r.t, JSON.stringify(r.d).slice(0,200)); if(r.t==='auth'&&r.d.ok&&step===0){step=1; ws.token=r.d.token; send('logout',{token:ws.token});} else if(r.t==='auth'&&r.d.ok&&step===1){step=2; send('login',{username:'tester01',password:'secret123'});} else if(r.t==='auth'&&r.d.ok&&step===2){step=3; send('session',{token:r.d.token});} else if(r.t==='auth'&&r.d.ok&&step===3){step=4; console.log('FULL AUTH FLOW OK'); ws.close(); process.exit(0);} else if(r.t==='auth'&&!r.d.ok){console.log('AUTH ERR:',r.d.msg); process.exit(1);} }); ws.on('error',(e)=>{console.error('ERR',e.message); process.exit(1);}); setTimeout(()=>{console.error('TIMEOUT at step',step); process.exit(1);},8000);")

Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)
